settings.question: How fast do I get a custom 10x10 tent?
settings.answer: Five business days from approved proof to ship — guaranteed, nationwide.

settings.question: Will the print fade outdoors?
settings.answer: No. Dye sublimation bonds the ink into the fabric, so it holds color in sun and weather far longer than surface vinyl.

settings.question: Do I see it before it prints?
settings.answer: Yes — we send a free digital proof and nothing goes to production until you approve it.

settings.question: Can you match my exact brand colors?
settings.answer: Yes. Send your logo and color values; our LA production team matches them before printing.

settings.heading: Custom 10x10 Event Tent
settings.intro: The 10x10 is the hardest-working tent at any show — full 30 feet of branded canopy, printed edge-to-edge and delivered in 5 business days. Free proof before you pay.
settings.benefits:
• Full-color dye-sublimation print, edge to edge — no blank panels
  • Reinforced powder-coated aluminum frame, pop-up, no tools
  • Wheeled carry bag included
  • Free digital proof before production — nothing prints without your approval
  • Custom-made in Los Angeles, 20+ years in sublimation
settings.close_sub: Send your logo. Get a free proof back — no charge, no commitment.
